summary.text: Andrew Byron is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 22, serving since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Byron was born in Jackson, Wyoming, lives in Teton County and graduated from Jackson Hole High School.

Byron earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 2008, and Byron's career experience includes working as a real estate agent and volunteering as a lieutenant for Jackson Hole Fire/EMS.
Byron assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023.
For 2025-2026, Byron chairs the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and co-chairs the Air Transportation Liaison Committee.
